INSERT INTO transcript_segments (
                    transcript_source_id,
                    library_id,
                    media_id,
                    media_type,
                    media_file_id,
                    language_code,
                    cue_index,
                    start_ms,
                    end_ms,
                    cue_text,
                    segment_hash,
                    status,
                    metadata
                ) VALUES (
                    $1,
                    $2,
                    $3,
                    ($4::text)::media_type,
                    $5,
                    $6,
                    $7,
                    $8,
                    $9,
                    $10,
                    $11,
                    'active',
                    $12
                )
